Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Platform

About the role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own core payment services.
You will act as the primary liaison between platform and risk teams.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate high-throughput services in Python or Go.
- Lead system design reviews and mentor engineers.
- Improve reliability, observability, and on-call health.

Requirements
- 6+ years of backend experience.
- Must have: Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and distributed systems knowledge.
- Experience running services on Kubernetes in AWS.

Nice to have
- gRPC, Terraform, and payment-industry experience.
